skills.name: Spaceship Command
skills.description: The basics of holding a hull steady and answering the helm. Required before any ship can be trained, and each level tightens how sharply every hull comes about.

skills.name: Motor Torpedo Boat Control

unlocks.description: Operate a Motor Torpedo Boat; requires the paired system-management skill at level 5 as well.

skills.description: Conning a Motor Torpedo Boat: helm, throttle and evasive handling. Level 5 is half the requirement to take one out; past that, each level sharpens how the hull handles. An entry hull: nothing but Spaceship Command comes before it.

skills.name: Motor Torpedo Boat System Management

unlocks.description: Operate a Motor Torpedo Boat; requires the paired system-management skill at level 5 as well.

skills.description: Running a Motor Torpedo Boat's internals: power routing, damage-control parties and standing repairs. The other half of the level-5 requirement to operate the hull. An entry hull: nothing but Spaceship Command comes before it.

skills.name: Navigation
skills.description: Course plotting and throttle discipline. Each level adds 1% to ship speed.

skills.name: Scanning

unlocks.description: Scan the current system for contacts and sites.
Resolve an enemy contact into a hull and loadout.
Hold a weapons lock on an enemy ship.

skills.description: Survey and targeting sensors. Opens up scanning the universe, scouting enemy contacts, and holding a lock on an enemy ship.

skills.name: Maintenance
skills.description: Standing repair work under way. The higher the skill, the better the repair rate.

skills.name: Energy Shields
skills.description: Shield generator tuning. The higher the skill, the faster the recharge rate.

skills.name: Damage Control
skills.description: Handling critical damage: hull breach, reactor fire, reactor failure, bridge failure, computer system failure. Higher levels improve the chance of containing each of them.

skills.name: Electronics
skills.description: Fire-control computers, ECM sets and sensor processing -- the effectiveness of a ship's electronic systems.

skills.name: Ballistic Weapon
skills.description: Autocannons, railguns and gauss -- anything that throws mass. Below level 5 the weapon suffers a 50% damage and accuracy debuff; level 5 clears it, and each level after that adds 5% effectiveness.

skills.name: Energy Weapon
skills.description: Lasers, plasma and particle weapons. Below level 5 the weapon suffers a 50% damage and accuracy debuff; level 5 clears it, and each level after that adds 5% effectiveness.

skills.name: Missiles
skills.description: Missile racks, torpedo tubes and seeker ordnance. Below level 5 the weapon suffers a 50% damage and accuracy debuff; level 5 clears it, and each level after that adds 5% effectiveness.

skills.name: Drones
skills.description: Combat drones flown from a hangar bay rather than fired from a mount. Below level 5 the weapon suffers a 50% damage and accuracy debuff; level 5 clears it, and each level after that adds 5% effectiveness.

skills.name: Formation Drill

unlocks.description: Second ship in the fleet.
Third ship in the fleet.
Fourth ship in the fleet.
Fifth ship in the fleet -- the maximum.

skills.description: Working more than one hull as a unit. Each gate adds a ship to the fleet; the first ship needs no drill at all.

skills.name: Attacking Formation
skills.description: Offensive station-keeping. Each level adds 1% to accuracy, damage, navigation and weapon tracking across every ship in the fleet.

skills.name: Defensive Formation
skills.description: Defensive station-keeping. Each level adds 1% to maintenance, energy shields, damage control, damage reduction and evasion across every ship in the fleet.

skills.name: Mining Operation Formation
skills.description: Running a fleet as a mining detail. Each level adds 2% to the mining output of every ship in the fleet.

skills.name: Regroup and Hold
skills.description: Re-forming after disruption. Heavy damage scatters a fleet, and a scattered fleet loses every fleet bonus until it re-forms; each level brings the survivors back into formation faster.

skills.name: Fighter Squadron Control
skills.description: Directing fighter and bomber squadrons. Each level adds 1% to squadron speed, accuracy and evasion.

skills.name: Science

unlocks.description: Mining and raw-resource production skills become trainable.
Material refinement skills become trainable.
Manufactory and ship-construction skills become trainable.

skills.description: Theory before practice. Nothing in mining, production or refining can be trained until Science reaches the level that opens it -- raw operations first, then refining, then fabrication.

skills.name: Planetary Resource Production
skills.description: Running extraction on a planet. Each level adds 3% to planetary production rate.

skills.name: Planetary Production Management
skills.description: Warehousing and throughput. Each level adds 10% to how much resource a site can hold.

skills.name: Material Refinement Management
skills.description: Planetary and station refineries. Each level recovers 1% more material from the raw feedstock, against a lane yield that can never reach 1.

skills.name: Manufactory Management
skills.description: Fabricating finished components from refined material. Each level adds 3% to manufacturing rate.

skills.name: Ship Construction Management
skills.description: Laying down hulls in a yard. Each level adds 3% to construction rate.

skills.name: Mining Equipment Operation

unlocks.description: Fit and run standard mining equipment.

skills.description: Operating standard mining gear. Each level cuts cycle time by 2%.

skills.name: Advanced Mining Equipment Operation

unlocks.description: Fit and run advanced mining equipment.

skills.description: Operating advanced mining gear. Each level cuts cycle time by a further 3%.

skills.name: Mining Effectiveness
skills.description: Getting more out of each cycle. Each level adds 3% to mining yield.

skills.name: Advanced Mining Effectiveness
skills.description: Yield optimisation on advanced gear. Each level adds a further 4% to mining yield.

skills.name: Trade
skills.description: Buying and selling. Each level improves the margin a player trades at by 2%.

skills.name: Union Management
skills.description: Running a union -- a league of many players. Each level raises the member cap by 5.

startingPackage.gateSkillsGranted: both ship_operation claimants of the chosen hull, at level 5
